name: Lancy Co., Ltd.
summary: Lancy Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, production, and sale of apparel and medical services in China and internationally. The company offers women's clothing under the LANCY, LIME, MoJo S.Phine, and m.tsubomi brands; and children's clothing under the Agabang, ETTOI, DearBaby, 2ya2yao, Putto, Design Skin, and other brand name. It is also involved in the medical beauty business under the Milan Baiyu and HANJIN brands; provision of medical rejuvenation services under the Jingfu brand; and operation of medical cosmetology centers, including cosmetic surgery, dermatology, traditional Chinese medicine, micro plastic surgery, and cosmetic dentistry under the Gao Yis…
